reconstructed_captions.33: The man's gloved hands are shown arranging a bundle of tinder on the snow.
reconstructed_captions.34: He carefully fluffs up the tinder, which appears to be shredded birch bark.
reconstructed_captions.35: He forms the tinder into a small nest shape, ready for lighting.
reconstructed_captions.36: He pulls a lighter out of his pocket.
reconstructed_captions.37: He holds the flame of the lighter to the base of the tinder bundle.
reconstructed_captions.38: The tinder begins to catch and produce a wisp of smoke.
reconstructed_captions.39: He continues to apply the flame as the tinder smolders more intensely.
reconstructed_captions.40: He pulls the lighter away and gently blows on the smoking tinder.
reconstructed_captions.41: An ember glows brightly in the center of the tinder bundle.
